name: file-preview
description: Click a markdown, JSON or YAML file link in a reply to preview it in a side pane, drawn like a docs page

highlighters.title: External highlighters
highlighters.description: One entry per command, as `<language>[, <language>…]: <command> [args…]` (double quotes group a path with spaces). The command gets the code on stdin and writes JSON [text, capture] spans (tree-sitter capture names). Languages without an entry use Claude Code's own highlighter.
